facts.business: Rathi Bars Limited is a manufacturing company listed on BSE, engaged in steel/iron production as indicated by related party transactions with Rathi Special Steels Limited and Bhiwadi Iron Private Limited, and compliance with environmental and factory laws.

auditor.name: M/s Siya Ram & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Auditor reported qualifications/reservations/adverse comments/disclaimers; Board gave replies. Specific observations include discrepancies in shareholding pattern filings, non-submission of Annual Compliance Report for FY 2023-24, incorrect ASCR reporting on SAST Regulations applicability, XBRL-PDF mismatch, and non-submission of standalone financial results in XBRL mode for Q4 FY25.

key_risks: Secretarial audit qualifications and regulatory compliance discrepancies
Related party transaction concentration with Rathi Special Steels Limited and Bhiwadi Iron Private Limited (up to Rs 100 crore each in FY 2026-27)
Non-compliance with SEBI LODR filing requirements (XBRL, shareholding patterns, annual compliance reports)
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved for FY 2026-27: up to Rs 100 crore with Rathi Special Steels Limited and up to Rs 100 crore with Bhiwadi Iron Private Limited, both at arm's length and in ordinary course of business. Investments held: Gordhan Das Rathi Steels Limited shares (Rs 7,66,289) and National Saving Certificates (Rs 6,045).
